branches.title: Branches
branches.returnNote: Returns are possible 24 hours a day.
branches.imageHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, 4 MB at most. Shown on the Branches page.

categories.title: Categories
categories.imageHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, max 4 MB.
categories.name: Name
categories.optional: optional, falls back to the Dutch name

classes.title: Vehicle classes
classes.adminOnly: Only admins can delete vehicle classes.
classes.optional: optional, falls back to the Dutch name
classes.transmissionsHint: Pick at least one. With more than one, the client chooses when booking.
classes.fuelHint: Pick at least one. With more than one, the client chooses when booking; the fuel affects the price.

extras.title: Extra options
extras.adminOnly: Only admins can delete extra options.
extras.optional: optional, falls back to the Dutch title
extras.maxHint: The most the client can choose.

unitHint.per_day: The price is multiplied by the number of rental days (every started 24 hours counts).
unitHint.per_unit: The client chooses the quantity; the price is per unit, charged once.
unitHint.per_time: The price is charged once per rental.

extras.classesHint: Choose the classes this option is offered for. A class without a coupling does not get the option.
extras.noClassesExist: There are no vehicle classes yet.
extras.noneSelected: No class coupled yet: the option is not offered anywhere.

prices.title: Prices
prices.vatNote: All prices exclude VAT; {rate}% VAT is added at checkout.
prices.halfDayNote: A half day applies up to {hours} hours. The client automatically pays the cheapest combination.
prices.reducible: can be lowered to {amount} for {price} per day
prices.fill: Fill empty tariffs from the day price
prices.noCombinations: This class has no fuel type or transmission yet.
prices.ownRiskHint: Leave "Reduced to" and the price empty if the client cannot lower the own risk. Lowering it to € 0 is allowed.
prices.depositHint: The deposit is at least this base amount and at least the price incl. VAT + € {margin}, rounded up to € {step}. If the client keeps the full own risk, € {surcharge} is added. No deposit is needed for rentals of {days} days or more (leasing).
prices.kmHint: The number of kilometres in the rental price, fixed per rental (not per day). Clients can book extra kilometres at the per-km price above; kilometres driven beyond that are settled after the return at the same price. 0 = no kilometres included.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.intro: After booking, a booking is "not confirmed" yet. Check the availability, then confirm or cancel the booking. This is a demo: no emails are sent.
bookings.confirmHelp: The vehicle is available: the customer gets the confirmation (demo: nothing is really sent).

customers.title: Customers
customers.search: Search by name, email, phone or city
customers.hasBookings: This customer has bookings and cannot be deleted.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm booking {reference}
confirmDialog.demo: Nothing is sent now. In the real system the customer ({email}) will automatically receive the booking details and the confirmation by email. Here only the status is set to confirmed.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Admins and employees who can sign in to the back office. Admins can do everything; employees can manage bookings, customers and the catalogue, but cannot delete users or branches.
users.passwordHint: At least {n} characters. Leave empty to keep the password.
users.passwordRequired: At least {n} characters. The user can change it on My profile.
users.roleSelf: You cannot change your own role.
users.selfDelete: You cannot delete your own account.

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: Name
profile.hint: At least {n} characters and different from your current password.

visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.intro: Only visible to you as the owner. Visits to the public website. Anonymous: no IP address or cookie is stored, only page, time, device and origin. Visits by you, logged-in staff and robots are not counted.
visitors.visitorsHint: A visitor is counted once per day.
visitors.ignored: Visits from this address are not counted.
visitors.notIgnored: Visits from this address ARE counted. Put it in .env under VISITOR_IGNORED_IPS and clear the config cache to exclude your own visits.

checkout.title: Rental details
checkout.summaryEmpty: Choose your pick-up and return details to continue.
checkout.hoursHint: Pick-up is possible during the branch's opening hours (not on weekends). You can return to any branch, 24 hours a day.
checkout.choiceRequired: Choose the fuel for this vehicle.
checkout.nextSoon: Fill in your details and press Book. This is a demo site: nothing is really booked or paid.

extras.title: Extra options
extras.subtitle: Choose what you would like to add. The price is calculated in the summary.

price.title: Price
price.ownRiskAmount: Own risk in case of damage: {amount}
price.reduce: Lower the own risk to {reduced} for {price} per day
price.noDeposit: No deposit needed: a rental of {days} days or more is leasing.

client.title: Your details
client.has_valid_license: I hold a valid driving licence
client.accept_terms: I agree to the terms and conditions
client.needPeriod: First check your rental details and press Update.

errors.name: Use only letters, spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens.
errors.dobInvalid: Enter a valid date of birth.
errors.dobFuture: The date of birth must be in the past.
errors.tooYoung: You must be at least {age} years old on the pick-up date.
errors.house: Enter a valid house number, for example 12 or 12a.
errors.postal: Enter a valid Dutch postal code, for example 3013 AJ.
errors.license: You must confirm that you hold a valid driving licence.
errors.terms: You must accept the terms and conditions.

order.title: This is a demo site
order.notice: Nothing has been booked and nothing has been charged. Below is your order as it would be booked.

next.title: What happens next?
next.step1: After you book, you and Rentacar both receive an email with the status "not confirmed yet".
next.step2: Rentacar checks whether the vehicle is available for your period.
next.step3: If the booking is possible, Rentacar confirms it and you receive a second email with the confirmation.

km.title: Kilometres
km.extraHint: Do you expect to drive more than {km} km? Book extra kilometres in advance. Kilometres driven beyond the total are settled after the return.
km.unavailable: Extra kilometres cannot be booked for this choice.
km.beyond: Every kilometre driven beyond that is settled after the return at {price} per km (excl. VAT).

checkout.specsSubtitle: Choose the fuel and the transmission.
